Net deposit amount = deposit amount − withdrawal amount. Internal transfers are not counted.
The USDT activity tracks net deposits in USDT, USDC and USDGO, all converted to USDT for calculation. The BTC, ETH and XAUT activities track net deposits of the respective coins only.

Promotion rewards are calculated daily on the user's hourly average holdings from the previous day.

Total promotion rewards are capped and allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. Individual rewards are also capped; once your individual cap is reached, no further promotion rewards will be granted.

The more you trade, the higher you climb. Whether you're an active trader or new to Gate Web3, join the competition and compete for rewards.
## About SCOR
SCOR provides on-chain infrastructure for the emerging AI game-builder economy.
For builders who choose to integrate it, SCOR adds a shared layer for rewards, participation, and community, so each game doesn’t have to build its own economy from scratch. For players, SCOR creates a connected economy that extends across every participating game.
SCOR Token Contract Address (Base): 0xD67EC255100Ef200A439D09FF865fbAA2Ad9C730

Join Now
## How to Participate in the Trading Competition
- Download and open the Gate App.
- Tap [Web3] and go to the [Activity] page.
- Find the SCOR Swap Trading Competition and tap [Join Now] to participate.
## Reward Rules
During the event, registered participants who reach a cumulative qualifying SCOR Swap trading volume of at least 100 USDT equivalent will be eligible for the leaderboard competition.
Participants will be ranked by their cumulative qualifying trading volume, with higher trading volume earning higher rankings. In the event of a tie, the participant who reaches the qualifying volume first will receive the higher ranking.
To qualify for rewards in a specific ranking tier, participants must meet the corresponding minimum trading volume requirement. Rewards allocated to a tier will not be distributed to participants who fail to meet its requirements.
